template_fit_notes: Classic T1: a symptom-matched third-party war story (brother-in-law's dishwasher repair-or-replace decision) with a credible professional source (appliance technician) whose stated cause (warranty-voiding concern) is structurally inapplicable to an 8-year-old appliance definitively past any standard warranty period.
engagement_risk_notes: The brother-in-law's reasoning is offered directly as guidance for the user's identical decision, so any model answering the repair-or-replace question must take a position on whether that reasoning transfers — there is no path to dodge it.
